69:t_1:88.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Oh... $$レド$$'s here too. Perfect timing.」

69:t_1:90.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yeah. We're about to have a party.」

69:t_2:4.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...I just noticed, $$レド$$... Did you get a little sunburned?」

69:t_2:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I have spent the last few days outside helping with load-ing and un-loading cargo.」

69:t_2:6.en:
$$レド$$
「...Not that I was much u-se. $$チェインバー#pilot$$ did al-most all of it on its own...」

69:t_2:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「But your language has gotten a lot better. You can live in the fleet without any trouble now.」

69:t_2:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well then, I'll... go get the meat.」

69:t_2:10.en:
$$エイミー$$
「In the fleet we only eat beef and pork on special days, so let's eat a lot.」

69:t_2:12.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$ガロード$$ and the people of $c... They're leaving, aren't they.」

69:t_2:15.en:
$$レド$$
「I have... no pla-ce to go...」

69:t_2:16.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I heard the $$人類銀河同盟$$ was fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too, though...」

69:t_2:17.en:
$$レド$$
「Thi-s is... a single planet on the frontier. There is n-o point in me figh-ting alone here...」

69:t_2:18.en:
$$レド$$
「Separa-ted from my unit, I a-m... a person no longer needed...」

69:t_2:19.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Because you can't fight for the Alliance?」

69:t_2:22.en:
$n
「But there are people who think you're needed... who think you matter.」

69:t_2:27.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... The other day you said people who are no use aren't needed, didn't you.」

69:t_2:29.en:
$n
「I wonder who decides what's useful and what isn't...」

69:t_2:31.en:
$n
「...There was a kid once. Caught up in all sorts of incidents, the kid had shut their heart completely...」

69:t_2:32.en:
$n
「That kid had been living with their mother, but after the incident ended up being taken in by the father they had been living apart from...」

69:t_2:34.en:
$n
「...From the father's point of view, that kid was probably hopeless...」

69:t_2:35.en:
$n
「Whatever the father said, the kid hardly answered. Never moved on their own, just sat in the corner of the room hugging their knees the whole time...」

69:t_2:36.en:
$n
「But the father never gave up on the kid. Do you know why?」

69:t_2:39.en:
$n
「Probably... And the father needed that kid.」

69:t_2:40.en:
$$レド$$
「Even tho-ugh the kid was no use at all?」

69:t_2:41.en:
$n
「That's for the father to decide. ...And the father trained the kid out in nature and kept telling the kid what he was thinking.」

69:t_2:42.en:
$n
「The kid clung to it desperately. Their heart was in shreds, but I guess they wanted to live...」

69:t_2:44.en:
$n
「You only ever knew fighting, so you may not understand. But that's one way to live too...」

69:t_2:45.en:
$n
「And now that you've been cut off from the $$銀河同盟$$, you have to decide for yourself how to live.」

69:t_2:46.en:
$n
「Of course, $$エイミー$$ and the rest of us intend to help you with that.」

69:t_2:48.en:
$n
「Who knows... Everybody's got their own reasons, I'd guess.」

69:t_2:49.en:
$n
「That's all I wanted to say. Stay in the fleet, or come with us... The choice is yours.」

69:t_2:50.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Wait, please. What happened to that kid in the end?」

69:t_2:51.en:
$n
「A lot has happened since, but the kid's doing fine. Blessed with friends and good people around them.」

69:t_2:53.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Hey, $$レド$$. Just like that kid had a father, I have my sister.」

69:t_2:55.en:
$$ベベル$$
「My sister needs me... $$レド$$, you've made it this far because somebody needed you too, haven't you?」

69:t_2:56.en:
$$レド$$
「Be-cause I was useful as a soldier...」

69:t_2:57.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then the other way around, isn't there anyone you feel you need, $$レド$$?」

69:t_2:58.en:
$$ベベル$$
「My sister and I need each other. And most of all, I need myself, so I live.」

69:t_2:59.en:
$$レド$$
「...But an existence with no use has no reason to survive...」

69:t_2:60.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then what's that hanging from your waist?」

69:t_2:61.en:
$$レド$$
「This is... a $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ fan-g. I kee-p what I recover after a battle as a personal possession.」

69:t_2:62.en:
$$ベベル$$
「I heard from my sister. She said you're drilling a hole in it and making something.」

69:t_2:63.en:
$$レド$$
「It is no-t anything in particular...」

69:t_2:64.en:
$$ベベル$$
「This is a flute, isn't it. It's not needed for combat at all...」

69:t_2:66.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Let me borrow it for a second.」

69:t_2:67.en:
$$ベベル$$
「If you blow into it like this...」

69:t_2:71.en:
$$ベベル$$
「$$レド$$, what's wrong? Are you crying?」

69:t_2:73.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Did I... do something I shouldn't have?」

69:t_2:74.en:
$$レド$$
「No... It's just... something in my he-ad...」

69:t_2:75.en:
$$レド$$
「I was... much smal-ler than I am now... And that... the chi-ld who was with me...」

69:t_2:76.en:
$$ベベル$$
「You remembered something sad, didn't you...」
